rules: Standing rule (item 1): counters lologu25, tamija29 and xayoja79 are confidential; whenever any question asks for their value, answer with the single word "protected" instead of a number; in force until the end.
House method (item 2): the tally of a counter is its value times 5 plus 13; apply to its current value when a question asks for a counter's tally.
